label: Clock arrival at a sink
subgoals: Add each buffer delay along the tree path to the sink
Sum them as the clock arrival at the sink

label: Skew between two sinks
subgoals: Compute the clock arrival at the launch and capture flops
Subtract launch arrival from capture arrival
Note that the source latency and shared trunk cancel

label: Propagated clocks in the setup check
section: Propagated clocks in the setup check
subgoals: Use each flop's propagated clock arrival in the check
Compute the setup slack with launch and capture arrivals
Switch from ideal to propagated clocks after the tree is built
